_meta.description: Member 7 of 11 in the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain. Extends the ThreeWayMatch schema declared by slice 01 with the per-trio identifiers (poLineId, grnLineId, invoiceLineNumber, productCode) and the operator's persisted disambiguationChoice that the multi-PO consolidation engine writes when one supplier invoice consolidates lines from multiple POs. Each (PO line, GRN line, invoice line) trio gets its own ThreeWayMatch record so the matching engine in slice 06 can process each independently through the tolerance path. The disambiguationChoice captures the candidate-tuple snapshot the crediteuren-administrateur picked plus the user id and timestamp so the audit trail in slice 11 can reconstruct the decision. Also extends the SupplierInvoice schema declared by slice 01 with header-level matchedPoIds + consolidatedAt and embeds the per-line PO link fields (linkedPoLineId / linkedPoId / linkedGrnLineId / linkedMatchId) on each invoice line so the SupplierInvoice document itself records which POs it consolidates: consumers reading the invoice see the PO links without traversing ThreeWayMatch records.

matchedPoIds.description: PurchaseOrder ids the consolidation engine linked to at least one line of this invoice. Captured at consolidation time so a consumer reading the SupplierInvoice document directly can see which POs the maand-factuur covers without traversing ThreeWayMatch records. Empty until consolidation runs; never includes duplicates.
matchedPoIds.title: Matched PO Ids

consolidatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most-recent multi-PO consolidation fan-out for this invoice. NULL until consolidation has run.
consolidatedAt.title: Consolidated At

lines.description: Embedded invoice lines parsed from UBL or OCR. Each line MAY carry the slice-07 PO-link fields (linkedPoLineId, linkedPoId, linkedGrnLineId, linkedMatchId) populated by the consolidation engine: the invoice document is the canonical surface for line→PO traceability so the UI does not have to traverse ThreeWayMatch records.

lineNumber.description: 1-based position of the line within the invoice.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

unitPrice.description: Unit price in integer euro cents (ADR-022).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

lineExtension.description: Line extension amount (quantity x unitPrice) in cents.
lineExtension.title: Line Extension

linkedPoLineId.description: PurchaseOrderLine id the consolidation engine linked this invoice line to (slice 07). NULL when the line is unmatched, ambiguous, or in the missing-PO exception state.
linkedPoLineId.title: Linked PO Line ID

linkedPoId.description: PurchaseOrder id of linkedPoLineId. NULL when no PO link.
linkedPoId.title: Linked PO ID

linkedGrnLineId.description: GoodsReceiptLine id the engine linked this invoice line to. NULL on PO-only matches (services) or unmatched lines.
linkedGrnLineId.title: Linked Grn Line ID

linkedMatchId.description: ThreeWayMatch id the consolidation engine produced for this line. NULL when no trio materialised yet (ambiguous pending operator disambiguation).
linkedMatchId.title: Linked Match ID

lines.title: Lines

poLineId.description: FK to the PurchaseOrderLine in the matched (PO line, GRN line, invoice line) trio. NULL on legacy header-level matches (single-PO whole-invoice records).
poLineId.title: PO Line ID

grnLineId.description: FK to the GoodsReceiptLine in the matched trio. NULL when no goods-receipt component (services, exception_missing_grn).
grnLineId.title: Grn Line ID

invoiceLineNumber.description: 1-based position of the invoice line within the consolidated SupplierInvoice the match refers to. Mandatory for per-trio records produced by multi-PO consolidation; NULL for legacy header-level records.
invoiceLineNumber.title: Invoice Line Number

productCode.description: Product code shared by the matched PO line + GRN line + invoice line (the consolidation key). Stored on the match so the exception workflow + vendor performance reports do not need to re-resolve through the line FKs.
productCode.title: Product Code

disambiguationChoice.description: Snapshot of the candidate tuple the crediteuren-administrateur selected when more than one (PO line, GRN line) candidate matched the invoice line. Persisted so the audit trail in slice 11 can reconstruct the decision without re-running candidate enumeration. NULL when the trio matched unambiguously (single candidate) or was created automatically by the matching engine.

candidateCount.description: Number of candidate tuples presented to the operator.
candidateCount.title: Candidate Count

chosenPoLineId.description: The PO line id chosen from the candidate set.
chosenPoLineId.title: Chosen PO Line ID

chosenGrnLineId.description: The GRN line id chosen from the candidate set.
chosenGrnLineId.title: Chosen Grn Line ID

rejectedPoLineIds.description: PO line ids the operator did not select; recorded for audit.
rejectedPoLineIds.title: Rejected PO Line Ids

chosenBy.description: User id of the crediteuren-administrateur who made the choice.
chosenBy.title: Chosen By

disambiguationChoice.title: Disambiguation Choice
